input.summary: Limit Vendor audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and remove remote access to Customer systems.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have limited audits to once in any twelve-month period on thirty days' written notice, during business hours and through an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and removed the right to access our systems remotely, consistent with our audit playbook and with the no-direct-access limit already in Section 22.2. If helpful, we can accept fifteen days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: No more than once in any twelve-month period, and on at least thirty days' prior written notice, Vendor may audit Customer's records relevant to usage of the Services during Customer's normal business hours. The audit shall be conducted by an independent auditor bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective as Section 16, and Vendor and its auditor shall have no access to Customer's systems.
